practice: Northgate Dental, 4 chairs, NHS + private, 11,400 patients

transcript.speaker: receptionist
transcript.text: Good morning, Northgate Dental, how can I help?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi, um, it's Helen Marsh, I'm a patient there — spelling M-A-R-S-H, date of birth the fourth of February, nineteen eighty-one.

transcript.speaker: receptionist
transcript.text: Thank you. What can we do for you this morning?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: I chipped a tooth last night, the back one on the top left, and it's, it's really sore this morning. It's not bleeding but it's catching on my tongue and I couldn't really sleep.

transcript.speaker: receptionist
transcript.text: Sorry to hear that. Any swelling or fever?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: My cheek feels a bit puffy on that side, and I was a bit hot in the night, but I haven't taken my temperature.

transcript.speaker: receptionist
transcript.text: Okay. Let me look at the diary.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: I can't do Thursdays at all, that's my day with my mum. And I'm flying to Lisbon on the twenty-fourth, so it needs to be before that if it can be.

transcript.speaker: receptionist
transcript.text: Understood. We have Tuesday morning or a week on Monday afternoon.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Tuesday morning's better. Oh — and it's my son as well, Toby, he's due his check-up, he's eleven now. Could you do him at the same time so I only take one morning off?

transcript.speaker: receptionist
transcript.text: I'll make a note. Anything else?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Just, will this be covered? I'm on the plan through work, band two I think, and I don't want a surprise bill. And roughly what does it cost if it isn't covered?

transcript.speaker: receptionist
transcript.text: The clinician will go through costs with you at the appointment.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Fine. Also, penicillin makes me sick — I had it years ago and came out in a rash, I don't know if that's on my file.

transcript.speaker: receptionist
transcript.text: I'll flag it. We'll see you Tuesday.

patient_record_excerpt.name: Helen Marsh
patient_record_excerpt.notes: Prefers morning appointments. Anxious — allow extra time.
